    Lemma 10.2 as stated: normalized, and in every weight #

    lem:mod-four-comparison (integral-deformations.tex): "Let μ̄ be a normalized Hochschild two-cocycle of A⁽²⁾ of internal degree q > 0. Then 2μ̃ is a coboundary in the normalized Hochschild complex of A⁽⁴⁾. The assertion holds separately in every simultaneous integer weight."

    2μ̃ is any μO with μO(a, b) = 2x whenever x lifts μ̄(πa, πb); it is a cocycle (isHCocycle_twice) and normalized (twice_one_left, twice_one_right). The coboundary of exists_hcobdry_twice is then normalized, h(1) = 0 (exists_normalized_cobdry). For ray weights hv : R → M lifting a mesh weight W (the rays Θ(b_r) homogeneous of weight hv r), the weight projections wProjO m of 𝒪P shift along products of ray vectors (wProjO_mul_left, wProjO_mul_right); if μ̄ has character χ, so has 2μ̃ (twice_char), and the weight-χ part of the coboundary is again a normalized coboundary of 2μ̃ (exists_normalized_cobdry_weight).
